title: From Feeds to Inboxes: A Comparative Study of Polarization in Facebook and Email News Sharing
eligible_reason: Descriptive article-date regressions (feols) of the Facebook-vs-email rank difference on GPT/LDA polarization, topic shares, article age and article controls, clustered by date; an election-period indicator T_elect (single common date, post-2020 election) interacted with polarization. No treatment adoption, no staggered design.
design_notes: R (fixest feols) plus Python notebooks for LDA and GPT scoring. NYT Most Emailed / Most Shared lists, 2019-2021.

specs.exclusion_reason: descriptive cross-sectional association; no treatment timing
single common date (2020 election) interacted with continuous polarization score

data_files_note: Ranking and article metadata from NYT trending pages (Internet Archive) and NYT API.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Descriptive study; not DiD.
